item.description:
A small polish pass on the conversation list and the per-turn breakdown.

  • Your first message opens the breakdown. Expanding a new conversation used to lead with an anonymous “(session start)” line, or a misleading “(continued from earlier)” on a brand-new chat. Now a conversation’s opening setup work folds into your first real message, so the breakdown starts with what you actually typed. “(continued from earlier)” is kept only for later days of a multi-day conversation that genuinely pick up where the previous day left off.
  • Command-only sessions show their command. A session you opened with a slash command but haven’t typed a message into yet (say a /compact) now names that command on its breakdown line instead of “(session start)”.
  • Total Cost carries the emphasis. In the expanded breakdown, the Total Cost column is now the darker, primary figure while the next-turn context charge sits back a shade, so the number you read down the column is the one that stands out.
  • Tighter list layout. Closed conversations no longer leave an empty gap where an open session’s status dot would sit, and the column header, day headers, and footer summary now line up with the conversation titles.
